title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary keep); Roblox's Korean game pages show most titles in English.

hud.cast.note: -기 button form: throw (the line). Fishing sense, not 캐스팅.

hud.reel.note: 'Pull (it in)'. Chose over 감기 (wind the reel), which also means 'a cold'; 릴 감기 is the fuller fishing term if the button has room. Same verb as the pass 자동 당기기.

hud.bait_left.note: Counter 개 after the number; no plural form, correct for 0, 1 and more.

catch.success.note: Rephrased to a noun phrase + 낚기 성공! (like 부화 성공!) so no particle follows {fish}; reads 희귀 황금잉어 낚기 성공!. Rarities are bare nouns (희귀, 전설, 신화).

catch.escaped.note: 'It' made explicit as the generic 물고기 (Korean needs a subject here); trailing ... kept.

catch.new_record.note: Latin unit with a space per the guide (100 Robux style); decimal point reads fine in Korean.

fish.golden_carp.note: Written as one word like a species name.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Loanword 랜턴 keeps the lantern idea and echoes the English title; one word like a species name. Native alternative: 초롱장어 (초롱 = traditional lantern, as in the real fish 초롱아귀), more poetic but less obvious to kids.

rarity.mythic.note: Standard Korean tier ladder ... 희귀 < 영웅 < 전설 < 신화; bare noun so {rarity} {fish} reads 신화 랜턴장어.

shop.equipped.note: State label 'in use', distinct from the 장착 button.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide pattern; Robux kept Latin, read 로벅스 so 에 is correct.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel. The pass name in Creator Hub should be set to match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: 행운의 미끼로 희귀 물고기를 낚을 확률이 2배가 돼요!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Particle 로 right after per the guide; 'your rare fish chance' = the chance of catching rare fish.

sell.done.note: Counter 마리 for fish, so no particle lands on the number; correct for 1.

sell.prompt.note: Guide key pattern (E 키를 눌러 ...). Developer: phone and console players have no E key; ProximityPrompt ActionText 판매 alone would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: 초월 (transcend) is a common Korean game term for a prestige step; avoids religious 승천 and climbing words, and stays distinct from 환생 (Rebirth).

ascend.confirm.text: 지금 초월할까요? 처음부터 다시 시작하지만 희귀 물고기를 {bonus}% 더 자주 낚을 수 있어요.
ascend.confirm.note: Same 초월 as the button; 'permanent' not added since the source does not say it.

weather.storm.text: 폭풍이 몰려와요! 희귀 물고기가 잘 물어요!
weather.storm.note: 잘 물어요 is the everyday fishing phrase for fish biting well; second sentence ends with ! to keep the excited banner tone.

quest.catch_n.note: Quest-line noun form (-기). Moonlit Bay = 달빛만, written like real bay names (영일만); 만 is neutral for a bay of a lake or the sea. Alternatives if 만 reads unclear to kids: 달빛 포구 (sea harbor) or 달빛 물가 (waterside, loses 'bay').

friends.boost.note: Stat-line ending with the + kept; statement, not an order.

trade.sent.note: 님 after the name fixes the particle for any name.

trade.accept.note: 'your trade' = your trade request, as context says; 님 fixes the particle.

codes.enter.note: Placeholder noun form, as in the guide's codes.placeholder.

codes.redeemed.note: 'Enjoy your reward' as 보상을 받았어요 (you got your reward): 보상을 즐기세요 is a calque Korean games do not use.

afk.kicked.text: 너무 오래 자리를 비워서 낚시가 중단됐어요.
afk.kicked.note: 'idle' as 자리를 비우다 (the guide's AFK wording); no removal from the server added.

event.ends.note: Guide pattern (이벤트 종료까지 {time}) shortened for the label. Developer: {time} as 2d 4h looks unfinished in Korean; format it as 2일 4시간.

daily.streak.text: 연속 출석 {day}일째! 내일 또 오면 보상을 더 받을 수 있어요!
daily.streak.note: Label-like 연속 출석 {day}일째 works for day 1; 'for more' made explicit as more rewards.

tip.night.text: 팁: 밤에만 미끼를 무는 물고기도 있어요.
tip.night.note: Restructured to the natural Korean 'there are fish that...' form; 팁: is the usual loading-tip label.

group.join.note: 그룹 / 가입하다 as in Roblox's Korean UI; 50 kept.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Biggest' = heaviest, so 무거운 rather than 큰; exactly at the 18 budget. Shorter option: 최고 무게 기록 (14). 월척 is the fishing idiom but many kids would not know it.
